description: Amazon is a global technology company focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing (AWS), and digital streaming.

faq.question: What does Amazon do?
faq.answer: Amazon is an e-commerce and cloud computing company. It offers online retail services, AWS cloud products, and logistics solutions.

faq.question: Do you offer cloud services?
faq.answer: Yes — Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides compute, storage, databases, analytics, and more.

faq.question: Is there a free tier for AWS?
faq.answer: AWS offers a free tier for many services with usage limits. Check aws.amazon.com/free for details.

faq.question: Who is Amazon for?
faq.answer: Retail customers, sellers, startups, enterprises, and developers who need cloud infrastructure or e-commerce solutions.

pricing.AWS: Pricing varies per service; a free tier is available for eligible services.
pricing.Logistics: Pricing varies by region and service.
